premise_correction: PlanBasis.r comes from rounded sigma half-width, not cost. Existing two-stage stop=-R, BE-trigger=+R, gross target=ceil-grid(1.38R), independent of C. Production TP1=ceil-grid(1.38R+C) is a different exit policy; its native distances are diagnostics, not substituted into this parity-bound experiment.

post_run_assessment.decision: No arm qualifies for deployment or the account goal. Lower-cost native admission adds 62 high-R entries with negative mean gross return.
post_run_assessment.premise: R and two-stage stop/BE/gross target are cost-independent at a fixed entry. Production cost-inclusive targets are separate diagnostics, not a replayed alternative.
post_run_assessment.horizon: Exact prior observation-boundary parity retained. Oil can enter during 07-17 UTC; NY/gold have four-hour windows. This is not a uniform four-hour holding-period experiment.
post_run_assessment.recommended_next: M0/M4 contract and complete round-trip evidence inventory; no further target tweak or production-cost reduction justified.
